Case note: R.C.S. No. 2642/2021
Client: Manoj Bhosale (general physician, Pune)
Opposing party: Charulata Sen
Court: Pune District Court
Filed on: 14 January 2021
Claim amount: 4.7 lakh rupees
Issue: tenancy eviction. The landlord is trying to evict the tenant after a rent increase was refused.
Advice given: Deposit the admitted rent in court to avoid an order striking off the defence.
Outcome: The tenant's defence was kept on record and the suit continues.
Recommended next step: Keep depositing the rent every month.
Witness: Asha Menon
